scripts.test: vp run mlbundle-docs#test && vp run mlbundle-playground#test:unit
scripts.lint: vp lint landing/src docs/src playground/src playground/tests --deny-warnings
scripts.check: vp run lint && vp run mlbundle-landing#check:format && vp run typecheck && vp run test
scripts.check:deploy: vp exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config landing/wrangler.jsonc && vp exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config docs/wrangler.jsonc && vp exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config playground/wrangler.jsonc
